description:
List the account voices

Returns the voices stored on this account, including cloned and generated ones, with the status that tells you whether a voice is ready to be assigned to an agent. The identifier is the platform form `voice_<number>`, which is what agent endpoints on this account expect. The response is not paginated and takes no query parameters: the full set is returned in one call, in insertion order. Access is governed by the `read:agents` scope rather than a voice-specific scope, because voices are only useful in the context of an agent.
name: list_voices
title: List the account voices
